headline: Kaya Limited: SEBI Takeover Disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Kaya Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), signalling a material change in shareholding or acquisition event subject to takeover code compliance.
detail: Kaya Limited, a multi-specialty healthcare and aesthetic services operator, submitted a disclosure of substantial acquisition to NSE on 30 June 2026 under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The filing indicates a shareholder acquisition event meeting the 5% disclosure threshold. The acquirer identity, consideration, and final shareholding percentage are not disclosed in the regulatory notice itself; these details are contained in the full Form DIS-4 filed with the exchange.
